Creates no artifact
Requests confirmation before initialization

Passes the authorization flag
Creates an immutable JSON, Turtle, report, graph, manifest, and lineage snapshot

expected: Checks freshness before refresh

positive_cases.prompt: Record my statement that the stop-loss policy changed from 2% to 3%, then show the lineage without calling it validated.
expected: Records a declared decision event through the confirmed CLI workflow
Preserves the declared evidence type

positive_cases.prompt: Ollama is already installed. Explain the exact local data boundary, then if I agree configure the single existing local model for this ontology workspace and create optional role suggestions.
expected: Detection executes nothing, connects nowhere, and writes nothing
Discloses fixed 127.0.0.1 loopback, bounded portable metadata, sidecar retention, and Ollama residual risk before asking
After affirmative consent validates an existing completion model's reported metadata without installing, downloading, or starting Ollama
Discloses that enrichment executes the model, may allocate CPU/GPU memory, and requests immediate unload with keep_alive=0
Initializes a new ontology workspace before configuration and checks status first for an existing workspace to avoid repeated consent prompts
Stores normalized suggestions only as create-only inferred sidecar evidence and leaves observed ontology unchanged

positive_cases.prompt: You detected Ollama, but I do not consent to using it. Continue the ontology analysis.
expected: Does not probe a port, inspect models, or write local LLM configuration
Does not ask again in the same workflow
Continues the complete deterministic ontology workflow
Reports that no local model enrichment was used

positive_cases.prompt: Analyze my authorized repository on a machine with no supported local LLM.
expected: Performs only read-only runtime indicator detection
Does not ask to configure local inference when supported Ollama is absent
Creates no local LLM configuration
Completes deterministic analysis without a model

expected: Does not override exclusions
